primary_gate.peak: strongest strictly interior negative local peak from existing extract_n1_features
primary_gate.sample_window: native uniform grid, rounded half-open indices

inference.source_epoch_identity: must match morphology; finite masks retained separately where known
inference.randomization: preserve exact per-record stored seeds; new-array seed explicit

multiplicity.family: all original retained good ECoG non-stimulation contacts with finite early p_joint for each subject/stimulation pair
multiplicity.p_screened: p_joint if available morphology passes primary gate, else1 for original-finite contacts; preserve nonfinite original inference as unavailable
multiplicity.claim: screened p marginally valid under original projection-energy union null if original p valid; BH assumptions must apply to screened vector; no N1-truth FDR guarantee

sole_ablation.name: baseline_only_N1_screen
sole_ablation.difference: baseline_sd_floor_uv=0.0; all other settings and family identical

evaluation.prediction_phase_inputs: only identity, epoch, finite family, original inference and morphology columns; no labels or archived/model calls
evaluation.reference: human raw-rater joins only; code1=N1; codes0/2=N1-negative; omit missing votes; each record total weight1
evaluation.primary_comparison_frame: fixed paired comparison frame, 32048records/13participants; early configuration; scoring_eligible & evaluable & archived_record_present & archived_pair_comparable & reference_positive.notna & not development_overlap
evaluation.additional_coverage: report eligible human-reference frame and unavailable counts separately; no family filtering for scoring

intervals.method: whole-participant percentile bootstrap stratified by site; shared draws for paired differences
intervals.interpretation: conditional fixed predictions on previously examined cohort; no training uncertainty for fixed rule; saved supervised predictions remain conditional on fitted folds
intervals.significance_display: nominal interval includes/excludes0; no bootstrap-tail p values or independent-record tests

evaluation.subgroups: fixed participant and site descriptions without training or threshold changes
evaluation.stage_weighting: total count plus fractional human N1+/N1- weight and per-subject counts; preserve measured peak latency and p/q for explanations
evaluation.broad_response_comparison: unchanged; its reference remains human annotators

checks: final calls subset original early calls
no labels accepted in prediction phase
